description.value:
Homebrew: automates the "Healing Transformation" spellshape feat. That feat's own real rules only append a reminder line to the next-cast polymorph spell's description (no actual healing automation exists in the base system) -- this item exists as a proper spell entry (type spell, vitality trait) purely for display/reference. The actual roll and healing are applied automatically by scripts/healing-transformation.js whenever this character casts Untamed Form (Weredragon Homebrew) while the Healing Transformation spellshape toggle is active, rather than being cast on its own.

You close wounds and patch injuries as you reach for a different shape. You restore a number of Hit Points equal to 1d6 per the rank Untamed Form was cast at.
